column3: Coming in grief is rendered as making a painful visit.
The singular one being grieved is rendered as plural “those.”
My joy being that of all is rendered as “you would share my joy.”
The relative clause about what has been forgiven is condensed.
“As captives” specifies the manner of being led in triumph.
From death to death is rendered as “death and demise”; from life to life is rendered as a fragrance bringing life.
“For profit” explains peddling; “men sent” specifies being from God.
